decisions.evidence: Original lift construction conflated chart inclusions with lifts; current step 4.1 defines maps Spec R to the charts via x,y mapped to t, and step 5.1 separates their closed-point images. The reader item correction is retained; the current contract is enriched with the Step-5 risk review.

Original valuation argument treated every field element as a monomial and checked quasi-separatedness on only two charts; current steps 1.1, 2.1, and 3.1 use compatible valuations, all primes, and the finite affine-cover criterion; steps 4.1-4.3 handle generic and closed images. The reader item correction is retained; the current contract is enriched with the Step-5 risk review.

For f=x^2 over a ring with 2 nonzero, current step 2.2 proves 2x is nonzero modulo (x^2) by degree, including when 2 is a zero divisor; the Jacobian presentation remains valid for f=0 and inseparable powers. The reader item correction is retained; the current contract is enriched with the Step-5 risk review.

The former proof assumed all product points lie in equal-chart opens Q_i. Current steps 1.2 and 2.1 cover only the diagonal image with Q_i, which suffices; multiplication B_i tensor B_i to B_i is surjective on each Q_i. The reader item correction is retained; the current contract is enriched with the Step-5 risk review.

The former proof inferred closedness of a preimage inside chart unions. Current steps 3.1-5.1 use a finite distinguished-open cover of an affine target open and quasi-compact diagonal preimages of each distinguished open. The reader item correction is retained; the current contract is enriched with the Step-5 risk review.

The original graph pullback square was wrong. Current step 1.3 identifies X times_Y X as the base change of the Y/S diagonal along g times_S g; composition with the X/Y diagonal yields the X/S diagonal. The reader item correction is retained; the current contract is enriched with the Step-5 risk review.
On U empty, locally free constant rank n holds vacuously for every n, contradicting uniqueness of n. The Definition now restricts uniqueness to nonempty U and explicitly records the empty case.

The final Statement sentence asserted coverage of every finite-type morphism, although the theorem assumes quasi-separatedness. Stacks Example 29.52.2 gives a finite-type non-quasi-separated morphism. The sentence is narrowed to finite-type morphisms that are quasi-separated.

The earlier clause inferred an attained finite infimum from nonzero H^0. The current clause allows +infinity when no uniform finite bound exists and asserts attainment only in the finite case. The reader item correction is retained; the current contract is enriched with the Step-5 risk review.

The original Definition called sheaf tensor contravariantly natural. Its current arrow F tensor G to F-prime tensor G-prime is covariant in both variables, as the presheaf tensor and sheafification adjunction require. The reader item correction is retained; the current contract is enriched with the Step-5 risk review.

The former proof identified G^q(V) with a product of the stalks of G^q, invalid for infinite products. Current F2 and step 1.1 use Godement coefficients A_x^q directly; step 1.3 kills degrees n-1,n,n+1 in the filtration lemma. The reader item correction is retained; the current contract is enriched with the Step-5 risk review.

The malformed sheafification notation a=# was corrected to a in the proof, preserving the compact-open finite-gluing argument and statement. The reader item correction is retained; the current contract is enriched with the Step-5 risk review.

The prior one-object patch I(F_2):=J did not define a supplied functorial resolution datum. Current steps 1.1-4.1 use the cone triangle and exact R_I Gamma, giving natural connecting maps and resolution independence. The reader item correction is retained; the current contract is enriched with the Step-5 risk review.

The Definition asserted component existence for every nonempty space without AC, but the cited supplier assumes AC and uses Zorn in step 1.2. The existence and associated global claims now state AC and declare def-axiom-of-choice.
